name: dsh-shell-expand
description: DSH shell-expand plugin: opens a running bash/pwsh tool row as soon as it has something to expand, so reading the command a call ran never needs a click. History stays collapsed, so Chat's collapse-timing setting keeps long transcripts cheap. It renders no card of its own: the shipped rows already wrap the command and report the exit status.

scripts.check:portable: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build && pnpm run check:bundle
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build && pnpm run check:bundle
